evidences.description: Scarab Swarm requires precise timing and positioning.

data.summary: Inaros Prime is a versatile Warframe with strong damage output through Scarab Swarm, decent survivability with Scarab Shell and healing in Sandstorm, limited support capabilities, and moderate crowd control. However, it lacks stealth abilities and has a reasonable level of complexity due to the need for precise timing and resource management.
